reason: Automates custom-provider model discovery enrichment by adding context limits, output limits, vision support, and reasoning levels, with optional metadata fetching and settings persistence.

summaries.zh: 自动为 DSH 自定义模型提供商补充上下文窗口、输出限制、视觉输入和推理强度等模型参数。
summaries.en: Automatically enriches DSH custom-provider models with context limits, output limits, vision input support, and reasoning levels.

capabilities: requests model metadata from configured provider endpoints and a public model catalog
enriches discovered model specifications in runtime
writes enriched model settings to the DSH settings file
